search_sri_ruc.summary: Buscar contribuyentes en el RUC del SRI por razón social o nombre comercial (texto parcial), sin necesitar el RUC exacto de antemano. Complementa get_sri_ruc_info (que requiere el RUC exacto) para el caso "conozco el nombre de la empresa, no su RUC". Cada resultado incluye estado, tipo de contribuyente, régimen, actividad económica, representantes legales, y si es agente de retención/contribuyente especial/fantasma — no declaraciones ni montos tributarios individuales. El SRI limita esta búsqueda a 100 coincidencias por consulta; si total_reportado sale en 100, puede haber más contribuyentes de los que realmente se están devolviendo — usa un texto más específico para acotar.

args_doc.max_resultados: Cuántos resultados con detalle completo devolver (máx 100)

search_tramites.description: Search gob.ec government procedures (trámites). Pass institution_id (SRI=8, IESS=163, Registro Civil=23, ANT=48, Cancillería=6; others via list_instituciones) for relevant results.
search_tramites.summary: Search for government procedures (trámites) on Ecuador's official portal gob.ec. Best approach: provide an institution_id to get that institution's trámites. Add a query to filter results by keyword (filters by name and description). When query is provided with institution_id, ALL pages of that institution's trámites are fetched and filtered, so you always get the most relevant results. Common institution IDs (checked against gob.ec's /instituciones 2026-10-07): - "8" = SRI (Servicio de Rentas Internas) — impuestos, RUC, facturación - "23" = Registro Civil — cédula, partidas de nacimiento - "48" = ANT — licencias de conducir, matriculación vehicular - "6" = Ministerio de Relaciones Exteriores — pasaportes, apostilla - "163" = IESS — seguro social, pensiones, fondos de reserva Use list_instituciones to find more institution IDs.

args_doc.query: Keywords to filter results (e.g. "RUC", "inscripción RUC persona natural"). Each word must appear in the trámite name or description.
args_doc.institution_id: Institution ID (strongly recommended for relevant results)
args_doc.page: Page number (1-based, default: 1). Ignored when query is provided (all pages are searched automatically).

get_serie_internacional.description: World Bank WDI indicators (wdi: set indicador, or query to search the catalog), IRENA capacity/generation by technology (irena), or hourly Colombia-Ecuador electricity flows since 2003 (xm). Defaults to Ecuador.
get_serie_internacional.summary: Fetch a series from an international source, filtered to Ecuador. - wdi: World Bank World Development Indicators (1,400+ series, yearly). With `indicador` (e.g. EG.ELC.ACCS.ZS access to electricity, EG.ELC.LOSS.ZS grid losses, EG.USE.ELEC.KH.PC kWh per capita) returns the series; with only `query` (English) searches the catalog. Years without a value are dropped and counted. - irena: IRENASTAT electricity installed capacity (MW) and generation (GWh) by technology, 2000 to latest, on/off-grid. - xm: XM Colombia hourly energy on the Colombia-Ecuador interconnection, summed to days or months. Requires desde/hasta. Blank hours (no flow) count as zero. Shows the Oct-2024 suspension.

args_doc.indicador: wdi only: WDI code. Empty with `query` searches instead.
args_doc.query: wdi only: catalog search text, used when indicador is empty.
args_doc.pais: wdi/irena: ISO3 code (irena also accepts the English name). Ignored by xm. Default ECU.
args_doc.desde: Start: a year (AAAA) for wdi/irena, a date (AAAA-MM-DD) for xm.
args_doc.hasta: End, same format as desde. xm allows at most 366 days.
args_doc.tecnologia: irena only: technology label substring (solar, hydro, Total Renewable...). Empty returns all technologies.
args_doc.tipo: irena only: generacion (GWh), capacidad (MW) or ambos.
args_doc.conexion: irena only: All, On-grid or Off-grid.
args_doc.sentido: xm only: exportaciones (Colombia to Ecuador) or importaciones (Ecuador to Colombia).
args_doc.limit: wdi catalog search only: maximum indicators (1-200).
